snippet.title: Coffee Talk Tokyo | Indie Fan Fest | Feb 2026
snippet.description:
Coffee Talk Tokyo is a cozy narrative adventure set in a late night café hidden among the neon streets of Tokyo. In a city where tradition and modern life coexist, the café becomes a quiet refuge from the summer heat, welcoming humans and fantasy beings alike to share drinks, stories, and moments of connection.
Players step into the role of the barista, preparing carefully crafted drinks that influence conversations and emotional outcomes. Each order matters, as the choice of ingredients and recipes subtly shapes dialogue, relationships, and character arcs. Through calm, intimate interactions, players listen, empathize, and help customers navigate personal struggles, transitions, and questions about identity, purpose, and belonging.
While maintaining the warm, relaxed tone of the Coffee Talk series, Coffee Talk Tokyo introduces a brand new city, cast of characters, and gameplay twists. New features such as hot and cold drink preparation, expanded latte art using sprinkle stencils, and Tomodachill, an in game social feed that reveals deeper layers of each character’s life, enrich the storytelling experience.
Accompanied by a lo fi soundtrack by returning composer Andrew AJ Jeremy, Coffee Talk Tokyo is designed as a slow, comforting experience focused on empathy, atmosphere, and human connection. A place to unwind, listen, and feel at home, one cup at a time.
